approvals.assetVisualDisposition: The short deterministic arc, exact two-to-one nearest-neighbor scale, ordered stagger and one exact amount label preserve the ultra-small identity, keep the map readable and avoid per-unit clutter.

nativeConsumption.trigger: newly accepted WorldFieldEventBatchV1 with sourceAction harvest and at least one positive harvested event
nativeConsumption.coalescing: sum repeated ResourceID amounts inside one batch and retain first-occurrence order
nativeConsumption.countTiming: toolbar count is already committed before frame one and never changes from presentation

motion.path: deterministic quadratic arc from selected tile centre to matching existing toolbar identity centre
motion.completion: remove travelling copy and acknowledge the existing destination; no mutation

nativeConsumption.queue: unique batchID FIFO while the same World owner remains active
nativeConsumption.dismissOrExpiry: finish current presentation and advance exactly one queued committed group
nativeConsumption.worldOwnerExit: navigation, encounter, return home or run change clears current and queued presentation only
nativeConsumption.relaunch: show persisted committed count and replay no mining presentation
nativeConsumption.missingIdentity: omit only the visual subject; never substitute art
nativeConsumption.playerCopy: retain canonical Use Tile and source-backed World narration only
